candidates.title: Dawn eclipse-archive alignment
candidates.setting: a dawn rooftop archive station surrounded by weighted star charts and a clockwork telescope
candidates.visible_action: aligning a historical eclipse tracing with the brightening horizon on a glass plate
candidates.complexity: layered charts, an analog timing dial, rooftop instruments, wind, and a changing dawn sky

candidates.title: Municipal celestial survey
candidates.setting: a municipal observatory rooftop at dawn with an analog transit telescope and city atlases
candidates.visible_action: drawing an azimuth line from the telescope sightline across a transparent city-map overlay
candidates.complexity: a brass telescope, mechanical chronometer, compass, coordinate grid, layered atlas, and wind-lifted survey sheets

candidates.title: Weather-front star cartography
candidates.setting: a dawn research rooftop with an anemometer, planisphere, barograph, and hand-drawn cloud map
candidates.visible_action: transferring the last visible stars and an advancing weather front onto a paper sky chart
candidates.complexity: cross-referenced sky and weather maps, multiple analog instruments, moving cloud bands, and sunrise color

candidates.title: Analog satellite-pass reconstruction
candidates.setting: a dawn rooftop reconstruction bench with a hand-cranked equatorial mount and topographic maps
candidates.visible_action: plotting a vanished satellite pass with grease pencil on a clear dome overlay
candidates.complexity: mechanical gears, arc rulers, grease-pencil marks, layered terrain maps, rooftop antennae, and dawn haze

selection_rule.description: Treat the frozen candidate array as zero-indexed and select seed modulo candidate count.
